subject: Renewal: Term & Capacity uplift — PO + evidence ticketing
messages:
From: Samir Patel <procurement@aurora-consulting.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal intake — term adjustment + capacity uplift (Aurora)

Hi Rachel,

Hope you're well. We're initiating Aurora's renewal for the 10/2028 anniversary. Two quick asks on our side so we can get procurement moving: 

1) We need an updated SOW amendment reflecting the term change to 24 months (from 12) and a capacity uplift from 8M tokens/month to 15M tokens/month.
2) Aurora's procurement team requires an evidence bundle (SOC2 report pointer, data retention summary, and contract redline) uploaded to our portal, plus a PO-ready invoice.

I'm attaching the initial SOW amendment draft we received from our customer success team for context (Aurora_SOW_amendment_v1.pdf). Can you confirm who on your side will own the PO-ready invoice and the procurement portal upload? Ideally we want to open a ticket in the next 48 hours so finance can align.

Thanks — Samir

--
Samir Patel
Head of Procurement, Aurora Consulting
procurement@aurora-consulting.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <procurement@aurora-consulting.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal intake — term adjustment + capacity uplift (Aurora)

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear ask.

Summary / next steps I propose:
- Redwood to produce an SOW amendment and updated invoice reflecting 24-month term + 15M tokens/mo (action: Karthik to confirm pricing uplift & invoice line items).
- We'll bundle SOC2 pointer and data retention one-pager into a procurement evidence zip and upload to the Aurora portal.
- I'll open the procurement ticket on your portal (please confirm the correct ticket queue) and include the evidence bundle and the invoice.

Karthik — can you confirm the unit price delta for the uplift and whether a staged billing approach (initial 3x monthly invoices at current rate, remainder at new rate) is feasible?

Samir — I can deliver the SOW amendment + invoice draft by Monday EOD (PST) if that timeline works. Also attaching a quick renewal_summary.csv with proposed quantities.

Attachments: renewal_summary.csv

Best,
Rachel
Senior AM — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal intake — term adjustment + capacity uplift (Aurora)

Rachel / team —

I reviewed the numbers in renewal_summary.csv. High level: moving Aurora from 8M -> 15M tokens/month is a ~80% usage uplift; recommended approach: 1) price the incremental tokens at a 20% discount to list to keep the net new ARR attractive, 2) offer an initial 60-day credit window to smooth usage variability.

For invoicing: finance prefers a single amended invoice for the term with a line for the committed monthly token allowance and an overage rate. If Aurora insists on staged billing, we can accommodate but need explicit PO notes.

Jonas — I put a couple of minor redline notes in the SOW PDF (forwarded below) around data retention and liability caps. Legal signoff required before we send the final SOW.

Onwards — I'll draft invoice lines by Monday and flag if there are any billing exceptions.

-Karthik
VP, Revenue Operations

From: Elena Torres <contracts@aurora-consulting.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 01 Jul 2028 08:34:00 -0700

Thanks — Laura looped me in. A few items from contracts: 

- Please upload the redline-ready SOW to our procurement portal under ticket #5542 so our internal legal can annotate in-line.
- Can you provide a dedicated evidence bundle (single ZIP) containing: SOC2 attestation link, data retention one-pager, and the single-page invoice? We prefer a single attachment to reduce administrative steps.
- We'll send a DocuSign envelope for the final SOW once legal and procurement confirm PO alignment.

Sending over the DocuSign link for the expected envelope after we receive the evidence bundle. Also please include any KMS/HSM notes in the evidence zip if available.

Thanks for the clarity. Deliverables and owners: 

- SOW amendment (redline-friendly PDF) — owner: Jonas Weber (legal review done by Thu 07/05).
- Invoice (PO-ready single-page) — owner: Karthik Iyer (first draft by Mon 07/02 6pm PST).
- Evidence bundle (ZIP with SOC2 pointer, data retention one-pager, KMS notes) — owner: Rachel Kim (I will upload to your portal under ticket #5542 once invoice is ready).

I will: 
- Open the portal ticket in the Aurora queue and attach the evidence bundle + preliminary invoice.
- Share the DocuSign envelope link back when Jonas confirms the SOW redlines are addressed.
